summary: An official warning states that taking Demeclocycline Hydrochloride during pregnancy can cause harm to an unborn baby [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this drug a high risk score for liver issues and a low risk score for heart issues [M]. In research, one clinical trial ended early due to low enrollment and staffing shortages, while another stopped because of patient complications unrelated to the study drugs [5][6].
